title: Instagram turns 16 with 3 billion users amid privacy, mental health scrutiny

title: Iran executes two protesters over police killings in January unrest

title: Ethiopia rejects 'coercive measures' on Red Sea and Nile rights

title: Euro falls to 19-month low on French fiscal, political risks
description: The euro fell to its lowest level against the US dollar since March 2025 on Monday as concerns over France's fiscal outlook and political uncertainty ahead of the 2027 presidential election weighed on investor sentiment and widened the spread between French and German bond yields.

title: Yemeni army seizes Dhubab and strategic Bab el-Mandeb sites

title: France Televisions drops Israeli firm from political program rollout

title: Estonia relocates troops near Russia in 'active defense' shift

title: Egypt demands Israeli withdrawal from Syria over 'flagrant violations'

title: Japan rules out new oil release after G7 coordination deal

title: Istanbul Airport stays Europe’s busiest with 1,587 daily flights
